title: James Fox's 2013 door-to-door search finds a farm hand who heard a boom
place_text: Near the crash site, Varginha, Brazil

tellings.quote: I just wanted to say that I too went with Marco in 2013 and I knocked on every single door of every house within a quarter or half a mile of that crash site and we found one farm hand in 2013.

plain: James Fox says that in 2013 he went with a man named Marco Leal to Varginha, a town in Brazil where, the story goes, something crashed. Fox says they knocked on every door within a quarter or half a mile of the crash site and found one farm hand who said he had heard a boom. If true, it would back the claim that something really came down there.
